accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) minimum. Use APCA for large text.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. disable parallax and heavy transitions.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (2px solid primary) on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to your index.css or index.html immediately.
THEME: Implement the 'paper' feel. Avoid pure white backgrounds in sections; use subtle noise or off-white (#f9f9f9) to reduce eye strain, but keep text high-contrast.
LAYOUT: Homepage MUST use the 'Editorial Hero' grid. Do not stack everything vertically. Use the 'Bento' concept but for news (Featured, Opinion, Latest).
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for functional UI (Modals, Forms) but style them to look 'Editorial' (sharp corners, serif fonts in headers).
NAVIGATION: Sticky header. White background. Black text. Simple. High contrast.
ARTICLE PAGE: This is the core product. Center the content. Max-width 65ch for readability. Large, dramatic hero image.
IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for 'Featured' and 'Community' sections. Do not use placeholders if possible.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
PERFORMANCE: Use 'next/image' for all images. Lazy load below the fold.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display'.
Do not use gradients for text or backgrounds unless it's a specific 'Breaking News' banner.
Use 2x more whitespace than you think is necessary.
Never use 'lorem ipsum' in final output if possible; use realistic news headlines.
Ensure the 'Contributor' section feels like a 'Masthead' (list of names/roles) rather than a social media profile grid.
